Short_Description: Set up this turn: Re-roll Charge rolls.
Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. You can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit in a turn in which it was set up on the battlefield.

Short_Description: Unit has Scouts 6".
Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Scouts 6" ability.

Short_Description: After deployment: Redeploy up to 3 ADEPTUS ASTARTES units; can place them in Strategic Reserves.
Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

Short_Description: TERMINATOR: Once per battle, end opponent Fight if unengaged: Unit goes to Strategic Reserves.
Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR model only. Once per battle, at the end of your opponent's Fight phase, if the bearer's unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, remove the bearer's unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Short_Description: -1 to Damage. If Melta or Torrent then Damage is just 1.
Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Each time an attack is allocated to the bearer, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack. If that attack was made with a Melta or Torrent weapon, change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 1 instead.

Short_Description: Tactical doctrine can be ON
Long_Description: CAPTAIN model only. At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, instead of selecting a Combat Doctrine to be active for your army, you can select the Tactical Doctrine. If you do, until the start of your next Command phase, that Combat Doctrine is active for the bearer’s unit only, even if you have already selected that Combat Doctrine to be active for your army this battle.

Short_Description: MELEE. Str +2, AP -1, Damage +1
Long_Description: Adeptus Astartes model only. Improve the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer by 2, and improve the Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of those weapons by 1.

Short_Description: Save 2+ and 5+ FNP
Long_Description:
ARMOUR OF ANTONINUS
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. The bearer has a Save characteristic of 2+ and the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

Short_Description: Save 2+ and 5+ FNP
Long_Description: Artificer Armour:  ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. The bearer has a Save characteristic of 2+ and the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

Short_Description: Leading = Infiltrator to Unit
Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Infiltrators ability.

Short_Description: +1 Damage for bearer only.
Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the bearer’s melee weapons.

Short_Description:
PSYKER: Advance & Charge.

BIOMANCY: Advance or Fallback & Charge.
Long_Description:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER model only. 
- When this unit is selected to make an advance move, that move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge. 
- When this unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if this unit has the Biomancy Discipline ability, that move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

Short_Description:
LEADING
Ignore all Modifiers
Long_Description: TACTICUS model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit can ignore any or all modifiers to their characteristics and/or to any roll or test made for them (excluding modifiers to saving throws).

Short_Description:
Deathwing. LETHAL HITS
VOWED = LETHAL on 5+.
Long_Description:
CHAMPION OF THE DEATHWING
DEATHWING model only. Weapons equipped by the bearer have the [LETHAL HITS] ability, and each time the bearer makes an attack, if it is within range of your Vowed objective marker, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+.

Short_Description:
+1 Attacks.
Once, Unit +1 Attacks also
Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer’s melee weapons. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by other models in the bearer’s unit as well.

Short_Description: MOUNTED. If unit is in Strategic Reserves, treat battle round as one higher when setting up.
Long_Description:
CHOGORIAN HUNTMASTER
ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED model only. If the bearer’s unit is in Strategic Reserves, for the purposes of setting up that unit on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

Short_Description: Phobos get Lord of Deceipt
Long_Description:
PHOBOS model only. The bearer has the following ability:

Lord of Deceit (Aura): Each time your opponent targets a unit from their army with a Stratagem, if that unit is within 12" of this model, increase the cost of that usage of that Stratagem by 1CP.

Short_Description: INFANTRY PHOBOS unit only. Attacks targeting a hidden unit have +1 to hit rolls.
Long_Description: INFANTRY PHOBOS unit only. This unit's attacks that target a hidden unit have +1 to hit rolls.

Short_Description: Deep Strike Turn 1
Long_Description:
DEATHWING ASSAULT
DEATHWING model with the Deep Strike ability only. The bearer’s unit can be set up using the Deep Strike ability in the Reinforcements step of your first, second or third Movement phase, regardless of any mission rules.

Short_Description: Turn 1 Deepstrike
Long_Description: Deathwing model with the Deep Strike ability only.  The bearer’s unit can be set up using the Deep Strike ability in the Reinforcements step of your first, second or third Movement phase, regardless of any mission rules.

Short_Description:
TERMINATOR: +1 OC
Once, Unit +1 OC also.
Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR model only. Improve the Objective Control characteristic of the bearer by 1. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of other models in the bearer’s unit as well.

Short_Description: HELLBLASTER. Snap shooting hit on 5+.
Long_Description: HELLBLASTER SQUAD only. This unit's snap shooting attacks hit on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

Short_Description:
PHOBOS + SHOOTING
Shoot + Normal move up to 6".
Cannot Charge
Long_Description:
EXECUTE AND REDEPLOY
PHOBOS model only. In your Shooting phase, after the bearer’s unit has shot, if that unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6". If it does, until the end of the turn, that unit is not eligible to declare a charge. This cannot allow the bearer’s unit to move more than once in your Shooting phase.

Short_Description: Gain CP
Long_Description:
EYE OF THE UNSEEN
DEATHWING model only. Each time you target the bearer’s unit with a Stratagem, roll one D6, adding 1 if the bearer is within range of your Vowed objective marker: on a 5+, you gain 1CP.

Short_Description:
LEADING 
Shoot after Fallback
Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, that unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Short_Description:
SUSTAINED HITS 1
Re-roll Adv in Dev doctrine
Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. In addition, while the bearer’s unit is under the effects of the Devastator Doctrine, you can reroll Advance rolls made for that unit.

Short_Description:
LEADING 
Hit or Saving = 6
Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, once per turn, after making a Hit roll or a saving throw for a model in that unit, you can change the result of that roll to an unmodifed 6.

Short_Description: Once. Go back to Strategic Reserves.
Long_Description: DEATHWING model only. Once per battle, at the end of your opponent’s turn, if the bearer’s unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, remove the bearer’s unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Short_Description:
MELEE + MOUNTED:
 +1 Strength and AP in Melee.
 +2 Strength and AP if Charge.
Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED model only. Improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons by 1. Each time the bearer ends a Charge move, until the end of the turn, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearers melee weapons by 2 instead.

Short_Description:
PSYKER: Ranged are ANTI-MONSTER / VEHICLE 5+. 

PYROMANCY: Grants SUSTAINED HITS 1.
Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER model only. This unit's ranged attacks have [ANTI-MONSTER/VEHICLE 5+]. If this unit has the Pyromancy Discipline ability, this unit's ranged attacks also have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Short_Description: Bearer has Stealth and Lone Op
Long_Description:
GHOSTWEAVE CLOAK
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. The bearer has the Stealth and Lone Operative abilities.

Short_Description: Bearer’s unit ranged weapons gain SUSTAINED HITS 1 and IGNORES COVER.
Long_Description:
HUNTER’S EYE
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.

Short_Description: Arrive from Reserves early
Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. If the bearer’s unit is in Strategic Reserves, for the purposes of setting up that unit on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

Short_Description:
RESERVES + MOUNTED. 
Arrive early from Strategic Reserves.
Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED model only. If the bearer’s unit is in Strategic Reserves, for the purposes of setting up that unit on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

Short_Description: Unit gets +1 Attack to Torrent
Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristics of Torrent weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit.

Short_Description: TERMINAtOR: Gets back up on 2+.
Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES ANCIENT model only. Each time an attack targets the bearer’s unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of the bearer’s unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Short_Description: CHAPLAIN: Ranged have IGNORES COVER.
Long_Description: CHAPLAIN model only. This unit's ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

Short_Description:
ANYTIME
 +1 OC for Bearer
 +1 OC, ONCE for Unit
Long_Description:
IRON LAUREL
Adeptus Astartes model only. Improve the Objective Control characteristic of the bearer by 1. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of all other models in the bearer’s unit as well.

Short_Description: CHAPLAIN: +1 to charge.
Long_Description: CHAPLAIN model only. This unit has +1 to charge rolls.

Short_Description: Fall back (re-rolling Desperate Escape), shoot and charge.
Long_Description: RAVENWING model only. The bearer’s unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back and you can re-roll Desperate Escape tests taken for models in the bearer’s unit.

Short_Description: Ravenwing reroll Advance and Charge
Long_Description: Ravenwing model only. You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit.

Short_Description: ANCIENT: -1 To Wound to Unit.
Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR model only. The first time the bearer is destroyed, roll one D6 at the end of the phase. On a 2+, set the bearer back up on the battlefield, as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with 3 wounds remaining.

Short_Description:
Within 6", remove model if Battle Shock.
ONCE, remove D3 models.
Long_Description: Adeptus Astartes model only. While an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) is within 6" of the bearer, each time that unit fails a Battle‑shock test, one model in that unit is destroyed (chosen by its controlling player).  Once per battle, when such an enemy unit fails a Battle‑shock test, you can choose for D3 models in that unit to be destroyed in this way instead.

Short_Description: LAND SPEEDER VENGEANCE only. Re-roll weapon Attacks rolls and Hazard rolls.
Long_Description: LAND SPEEDER VENGEANCE unit only. This unit can re-roll rolls to determine the A of a weapon and Hazard rolls.

Short_Description:
+1 Attack +1 Strength
 +2 Attack +2 Strength in Assault
Long_Description:
OATH OF MACRAGGE
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons. While the bearer is under the effects of the Assault Doctrine, add 2 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearers melee weapons instead.

Short_Description:
PSYKER: No Overwatch.

TELEPATHY: -3" detection range.
Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER model only. Enemy units cannot target this unit with snap shooting attacks. If this unit has the Telepathy Discipline ability, this unit has -3" detection range.

Short_Description: Plasma attacks have +6" R.
Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit only. This unit's plasma attacks have +6" R.

Short_Description:
LEADING
Re-roll Advance
Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for that unit.

Short_Description:
PSYKER, excl TERM: Reactive move D6"

DIVINATION: 6"
Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER model only, excluding TERMINATOR models. Once per turn per unit, in your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit, if this unit is unengaged, this unit can make a normal move of up to D6". Or, if this unit has the Divination Discipline ability, up to 6".

Short_Description: PHOBOS gets Lord of Deceit (Aura): Within 12", +1CP for stratagems
Long_Description:
SHADOW WAR VETERAN
PHOBOS model only. Gain following ability: Lord of Deceit (Aura): Each time your opponent targets a unit from their army with a Stratagem, if that unit is within 12" of this model, increase the cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.

Short_Description: PHOBOS model only. This model has Lone Operative and Stealth.
Long_Description: PHOBOS model only. This model has Lone Operative and Stealth.

Short_Description: +3" Pile in, Consolidate
Long_Description:
SINGULAR WILL
DEATHWING model only. Each time the bearer’s unit Piles In or Consolidates, models in that unit can move an additional 3".

Short_Description: +1 Strength and AP to melee weapons. If the bearer charged, +2 Strength and AP instead.
Long_Description:
SPEARPOINT PARAGON
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons by 1. Each time the bearer ends a Charge move, until the end of the turn, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons by 2 instead.

Short_Description:
MELEE. 
 +1 Attacks for Bearer
 +1 Attacks, ONCE for Unit
Long_Description: Adeptus Astartes model only. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer’s melee weapons. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by all other models in the bearer’s unit as well.

Short_Description: +1 to OC value
Long_Description: CAPTAIN, CHAPLAIN or LIEUTENANT model only. While the bearer’s unit is not Battle-shocked, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in the bearer’s unit.

Short_Description: TERMINATOR. Return 1 destroyed model in COMMAND.
Long_Description: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, in your Command phase, you can return 1 destroyed Bodyguard model to that unit.

Short_Description: While leading a unit, re-roll Advance rolls for that unit.
Long_Description:
STORMSEERS’ WISDOM
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for that unit.

At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, instead of selecting a Combat Doctrine to be active for your army, you can select the Tactical Doctrine. If you do, until the start of your next Command phase, that Combat Doctrine is active for the bearer’s unit only, even if you have already selected that Combat Doctrine to be active for your army this battle.

Short_Description: Aura to re-roll LD and Battleshock
Long_Description:
TEMPERED IN BATTLE
Adeptus Astartes model only. While a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit is within 6" of this model, you can re-roll Battle-shock and Leadership tests taken for that unit.

Short_Description:
PSYKER: Go Reserves at end opp Fight.  
TELEKINESIS: Grants Deep Strike.
Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER model only. At the end of your opponent's Fight phase, you can place this unit into strategic reserves. If this unit has the Telekinesis Discipline ability, this unit has Deep Strike.

Short_Description: Leading = Infiltrator to Unit
Long_Description:
THE BLADE DRIVEN DEEP
ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Infiltrators ability.

 +2 Attack +2 Strength in Assault
Long_Description:
THE HONOUR VEHEMENT
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons. While the bearer is under the effects of the Assault Doctrine, add 2 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearers melee weapons instead.

Short_Description: RAVENWING FLY unit only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.
Long_Description: RAVENWING FLY unit only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. The bearer has the Stealth and Lone Operative abilities.

SUSTAINED HITS 1
Re-roll Adv in Dev doctrine

In addition, while the bearer’s unit is under the effects of the Devastator Doctrine, you can reroll Advance rolls made for that unit.

Short_Description: Melee +3 Strength
Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY model only. Add 3 to the Strength characteristic of the bearer’s melee weapons.

Short_Description: Command: TECHMARINE selects VEHICLE 6", gain LETHAL HITS until next Command.
Long_Description: TECHMARINE model only. In your Command phase, select one ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model within 6 inches. Until the start of your next Command phase, weapons equipped by that model have [LETHAL HITS].

Short_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES: Feel No Pain 4+.
Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. The bearer has Feel No Pain 4+.

Short_Description: Once per battle round: failed save for VEHICLE within 6"; Damage becomes 0.
Long_Description: TECHMARINE model only. Once per battle round, when a saving throw is failed for a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model within 6 inches, change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

Short_Description: Command: VEHICLE within 6" to shoot after Advance or Falling Back until next Command.
Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. In your Command phase, select one ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model within 6 inches. Until the start of your next Command phase, that VEHICLE can shoot even if it Advanced or Fell Back this turn.
